item.title: [News] Meta Ignores Brazilian Court Order to End Bolsonaro Favoritism
item.description: Meta’s Instagram and WhatsApp AI ranking systems are being challenged by Brazilian civil groups for allegedly favoring the Liberal Party candidate in search results and linking the opposition to negative content. The Superior Electoral Court has ordered Meta to explain its ranking criteria and comply with a daily fine for potential bias.

item.title: [News] Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
item.description: Anthropic has donated its Agent Skills open standard to the Agentic AI Foundation, a Linux‑Foundation‑aligned entity, ensuring the standard remains community‑driven and vendor‑neutral. The move supports over 70 agent platforms—including ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, and VS Code—by providing a shared, versioned framework for specialized AI workflows.

item.title: [News] Human Capital Trends
item.description: Deloitte’s 2026 Global Human Capital Trends report highlights that businesses must become faster and more agile, leveraging AI and workforce analytics to quickly adapt to market changes. The study argues that a human‑centric approach to AI implementation yields higher returns than a purely technology‑focused strategy.

item.title: [News] FSI Predictions
item.description: Deloitte’s 2026 FSI Predictions report highlights a shift in financial services driven by AI, stablecoins, and blockchain, reshaping wealth management and insurance distribution. It projects significant productivity gains and market expansion as legacy systems are replaced by AI-powered operations.

item.title: [News] Cerebras Deploys Trillion-Parameter AI Models
item.description: Cerebras has demonstrated how its WSE‑3T wafer‑scale chips can run multi‑trillion parameter models like the open‑source Kimi K3 by partitioning the model across 59 wafers, enabling high‑throughput inference with 4‑bit quantization and efficient KV caching. The post details the memory layout, layer mapping, and inter‑wafer RDMA communication required to achieve 1,000‑2,000 tokens per second.
